review_focus:
Item P58.1 (#615), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P58.1 `annotations(tab)` and `ui_annotations(tab)`

- Branch: `epic/p58a-annotations-read`. Lanes: S, D, U, P. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P56.2.
- **Goal:** findings, threads, tour, checklist, triage, diagrams and the other bucket are read from resources.
- **Done when:** `annotations(tab)` is built from the AI section with thread ordering and counts on the server; `ui_annotations(tab)` is served by the desktop from `ui-annotations.json` in the tab's `TabContext::er_dir` (`er-service/src/protocol.rs:486`), the directory the App reads through `TabState::comments_dir()`, which returns `er_dir()` (`crates/er-engine/src/app/state/mod.rs:2168`–`:2170`), and bumped by its writes; `TabContext::comments_dir` (`protocol.rs:487`–`:488`) is the GitHub-comment bucket, the PR bucket on a PR tab, and no UI-annotation read or write uses it (`read_annotation_screenshot`, `commands.rs:11831`, takes a path and reads no directory); the sidecar reload watches the comments directory as well as `er_dir`: the AI section's stamp (`SidecarStamp::read`, taken in `load_tab` at `er-service/src/effect.rs:390` and compared in `reload_ai` at `:459`–`:460`, over `er_dir` only today) also covers the GitHub-comment sidecar in `context.comments_dir`, which the AI assembly reads from the PR bucket (`assemble_tab_ai`, `crates/er-engine/src/ai/tab_ai.rs:39`–`:55`), driven by P52.1's backend tick (A17) with no frontend call; the tick keeps `check_ai_files_changed`, since flag-on code reads the App's `tab.ai` until P61 (A17); `jobs` is first served here, with one part: the in-flight ask-AI replies (`pending_ai_replies`, `commands.rs:180`, on `DesktopState` since P52.1; `PendingAiReplies`, `snapshot.rs:2365`), keyed by thread or finding id as the map is today, with every insert and removal bumping `jobs`; with the flag on, DiffView and the AI cards join them with `annotations(tab)`, as `build_ai_snapshot(tab, pending)` (`snapshot.rs:4971`) and the hunk threads (`:2655`) merge them today; with the flag off the join does not run, because the snapshot's `ai` slice already carries the pending replies; P60.1 and P60.2 extend `jobs`; `load_tab` reads the sidecar stamps before the AI read, so an outside write between the two is not lost (#596 review); a write the workspace itself makes advances the AI section's sidecar stamp, where today the write keeps the old one (`content.rs:154`–`:155`, "the next reload reads this write back once"), so the tick's `ReloadSidecars` does not read the workspace's own write back as an outside change (#596 follow-up); a spawn failure in `SidecarReloads::start` (`er-service/src/sidecar_reload.rs:40`) removes the key from `running` (`:54`), so the next reload runs (#596 review); `annotations(tab)` carries the triage review update as a protocol type, so `TriageReviewUpdateSnapshot` (`triage_update.rs:13`) is flag-off only; the four read commands go through `er_fetch`; the entry stops reading `ai`, `tour`, `other_bucket` and `ui_annotations`.
- **Planted breaks:** one service `AddQuestion` moves the `annotations(tab)` version once across the next tick, and a write that keeps the old stamp moves it twice and fails the own-write test; on a local PR tab in Branch view, whose `er_dir` (its branch view bucket) differs from its comments directory (the PR bucket), an outside write to the GitHub-comment sidecar in the comments directory moves the `annotations(tab)` version with no frontend call, and a stamp that reads `er_dir` only fails that test, which first asserts that the two directories differ, so the fixture cannot fall back to a tab where they are equal; a separate outside write to `questions.json` in `er_dir` moves the version, and disabling the tick fails that test; `ui_annotations(tab)` on the same tab answers the annotation file in `er_dir`, and reading it from `context.comments_dir` fails; a stamp read after the AI read loses a write landed between them and fails the ordering test; a spawn failure that leaves the key in `running` makes the next reload answer false and fails; thread ordering done in TypeScript fails the source scan; an arena tick that bumps `annotations(tab)` fails the precision test; dropping the in-flight entry from `jobs` makes a flag-on `ask_ai` show no pending reply and fails the pending test; a removal that does not bump `jobs` leaves the "…thinking" reply showing after the answer lands and fails; the builder-parity fixture carries a pending reply, so a join that skips `jobs` fails it.
- **Fallback split:** P58.1a the builders, the reload and the first `jobs` part; P58.1b the desktop-ui port and the pending join.
- Size: L.

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
